scope: Active P1/P2/P3 (device-company adaptation: active pivotal IDE and feasibility IDE studies of own SCD device).

10k.note: 10-K describes Selective Cytopheretic Device (SCD) platform: one HDE-approved pediatric product (QUELIMMUNE) and an active pivotal IDE study NEUTRALIZE-AKI (NCT05758077, 339 subjects, 181 enrolled as of 2026-03-21) plus feasibility IDE studies in cardiorenal syndrome (NCT03836482) and investigator-initiated HRS (NCT04898010). Six FDA Breakthrough Device Designations awarded across AKI, CRS, HRS, ESRD, adult and pediatric cardiac-surgery indications.

website.note: Pipeline page lists QUELIMMUNE (commercial pediatric AKI), SCD pivotal in adult AKI, and SCD feasibility/Breakthrough programs in CRS, ESRD chronic hemodialysis, HRS, and cardiac-surgery systemic inflammation (adult and pediatric).

ctgov.note: All sponsor-matched studies are device IDE studies with phase=N/A and were filtered out by the P1/P2/P3 keep-rule. Re-included here per device-company rule (rule 4 in workflow).

pipeline.modality: Extracorporeal immunomodulatory medical device (cell-directed neutrophil/monocyte deactivation cartridge)
pipeline.target: Activated neutrophils and monocytes (calcium-mediated catch-and-release on hollow-fiber membrane)

indications.indication: Adult acute kidney injury (AKI) requiring CRRT
indications.highest_phase: Pivotal IDE (FDA Breakthrough Device Designation; PMA-track)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, open-label, randomized, two-arm comparative pivotal study; 339 planned subjects; primary composite of Day-90 mortality or dialysis dependency; control = standard CRRT.
key_milestones: BDD granted Apr 2022 for adult AKI immunomodulatory dysregulation

indications.indication: Cardiorenal syndrome (CRS) / right-ventricular failure awaiting LVAD
indications.trial_name: Feasibility of the SCD in Cardiorenal Syndrome Patients Awaiting LVAD
indications.trial_design: Multi-center, open-label, single-arm feasibility study; 20 subjects; SCD delivered 4 hours/day for up to 6 consecutive days; safety and mortality / MI / vasopressor endpoints.

indications.indication: Hepatorenal syndrome (HRS) Type I with AKI
indications.highest_phase: Investigator-initiated pilot IDE (FDA Breakthrough Device Designation)
indications.trial_name: SCD in HRS pilot (University of Michigan)
indications.trial_design: Investigator-initiated pilot, up to 10 ICU patients; 7-day SCD treatment; safety and effects on leukocytes, circulation, renal function.

indications.indication: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) on chronic hemodialysis (chronic systemic inflammation)
indications.highest_phase: Planned chronic-setting program (FDA Breakthrough Device Designation; pilot data)
indications.trial_design: Pilot feasibility data in 15 ESRD patients on chronic hemodialysis; controlled program planned.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED — controlled study to follow pilot

indications.indication: Systemic inflammatory response in adult cardiac surgery
indications.trial_design: Prevention of post-operative complications via intra-/peri-operative SCD therapy.

indications.indication: Systemic inflammatory response in pediatric cardiac surgery
indications.trial_design: Prevention of post-operative complications in pediatric cardiac surgery.
key_milestones: First pediatric BDD for SCD, granted Mar 27, 2025

products.name: QUELIMMUNE (SCD-PED)
products.approval: FDA Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) approved Feb 21, 2024
products.indication: Critically ill pediatric patients (>=10 kg) with life-threatening acute kidney injury due to sepsis or septic conditions and requiring kidney replacement therapy

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 3A randomized controlled trial terminated 2013 due to nationwide calcium shortage.
